label: All Documents Channel (Sync Gateway)
type: the special channel value that, when a document is assigned to it via channel(), makes the document visible to every user (as against sgw:all-channels-wildcard, the '*' grant value making a USER able to see every channel). Round 3's own extraction states this distinction explicitly rather than leaving it implicit.
aliases_note: This is round-3 promotion debt, not a round-27 finding: both corroborating files (access-control-concepts.json, channels.json) predate this round. Surfaced only because reconciliation runs recurrence.py over the whole corpus, not just the new batch.
note: 'This channel should not be confused with the use of the All Channels Wildcard in access grants' - the source's own non-conflation warning, extracted as shouldNotBeConfusedWith rather than left implicit.
